allow: PowerShell(foreach \($t in @\('rokit','rojo','git','stylua','selene','code'\)\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "$t = $\($c.Source\)" } else { "$t = NOT FOUND" } })

PowerShell($p = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit"; if \(Test-Path $p\) { "EXISTS: $p"; Get-ChildItem "$p\\bin" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } else { "NO ~/.rokit" }; "---PATH---"; $env:PATH -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -match 'rokit|roblox|foreman|aftman' })

PowerShell($u = \(Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\\Environment' -Name Path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Path; "USER PATH:"; $u; "---"; if \($u -match 'rokit'\) { "rokit IS in user PATH \(shell just needs restart\)" } else { "rokit NOT in user PATH" }; "---versions---"; & "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\rokit.exe" --version; & "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\rojo.exe" --version)
PowerShell($rokit = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\rokit.exe"; & $rokit add JohnnyMorganz/StyLua; & $rokit add Kampfkarren/selene; & $rokit install)

PowerShell($rokit = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\rokit.exe"; & $rokit trust JohnnyMorganz/StyLua; & $rokit trust Kampfkarren/selene; & $rokit add JohnnyMorganz/StyLua; & $rokit add Kampfkarren/selene; & $rokit install)

PowerShell(Get-Content "C:\\Projects\\ElementalSurvivors\\rokit.toml"; "--- bin ---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; "--- versions ---"; & "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\stylua.exe" --version; & "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin\\selene.exe" --version)

PowerShell($bin = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin"; Set-Location C:\\Projects\\ElementalSurvivors; & "$bin\\stylua.exe" src; "stylua exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; & "$bin\\selene.exe" src; "selene exit=$LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell($bin = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.rokit\\bin"; Set-Location C:\\Projects\\ElementalSurvivors; & "$bin\\rojo.exe" build default.project.json -o "$env:TEMP\\claude\\es-build-check.rbxlx"; "build exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; & "$bin\\rojo.exe" sourcemap default.project.json -o sourcemap.json; "sourcemap exit=$LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell($f = "$env:TEMP\\claude\\es-build-check.rbxlx"; \(Select-String -Path $f -Pattern 'Technology|GlobalShadows|StreamingEnabled' | Select-Object -First 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }\); "--- tree ---"; \(Select-String -Path $f -Pattern '<string name="Name">' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }\) -join " | ")
